name: Leaf Curl Virus
symptoms: Upward or downward curling of leaves Yellowing along leaf veins Stunted growth and reduced fruit size Severe infection can kill young plants
description: A viral disease causing curling and distortion of leaves, stunting growth and reducing fruit yield. Transmitted by whiteflies.
management: Grow resistant or tolerant cultivars Control whitefly populations Remove and destroy infected plants Maintain proper plant spacing
prevention: Start with virus-free seedlings Monitor whitefly populations Avoid planting near infected crops
